When the digital world gets overwhelming, return to something physical: a walk, stretching, even just noticing your breath or the feeling of your feet on the ground. These moments of embodied presence can be grounding reminders that you’re more than your inbox or your to-do list.

**3. Reflect regularly—without judgment.**  
Set aside time (weekly, if you can) to check in with yourself: What’s feeling energizing? What’s draining? What do you need more or less of? Treat these check-ins as acts of curiosity, not criticism.
